exo.robotica.piece.head: Exo Helmet
exo.robotica.unit.block: %s FE per block of fall absorbed
exo.robotica.unit.damage: %s FE per point of damage blocked
exo.robotica.module.rebreather.desc: Breathe under water. Draws power only while submerged.
exo.robotica.module.robot_hud.desc: Shows nearby drones and robots on your HUD.
exo.robotica.module.jet_assist.desc: Slows a long fall and adds a mid-air double jump (press jump again).
exo.robotica.module.flight.desc: Creative-style flight, toggled with K. Drains the battery fast while flying.
exo.robotica.module.kinetic_shield.desc: Absorbs incoming damage with stored energy instead of health.
exo.robotica.module.servo_stride_2.desc: Run 40% faster. Replaces Servo Stride I.
exo.robotica.module.servo_stride_3.desc: Run 60% faster. Replaces Servo Stride II.
exo.robotica.module.step_assist.desc: Walk up full blocks without jumping.
exo.robotica.module.magnet.desc: Pulls nearby dropped items toward you.
exo.robotica.tooltip.keys: Sneak + right-click: install modules. J: modules and switches, K: flight.
exo.robotica.tooltip.set: Wear all four pieces to share their batteries. Never breaks; empty still protects.
exo.robotica.no_flight: No Flight module in your chestplate
robotica.configuration.jetAssistPerDoubl: Jet Assist FE per double jump
robotica.configuration.kineticShieldPerD: Kinetic Shield FE per damage point
robotica.configuration.servoStride1PerSe: Servo Stride I FE per second
robotica.configuration.servoStride2PerSe: Servo Stride II FE per second
robotica.configuration.servoStride3PerSe: Servo Stride III FE per second
robotica.configuration.cellsRechargeSuit: Cells in the inventory recharge the suit
